scientific.integrity: The main inequality is analytic, from the exact competing-risk Laplace transform and strict Jensen convexity. A bundled standalone script replays the explicit exponential/fixed formulas and finite witness checks; finite checks are not used as proof of the general theorem.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is a constant-hazard, constant-inflow calibration benchmark. It does not order fully coupled epidemic trajectories, deaths, reproduction numbers, or controls when prevalence and vaccination-age susceptibility vary in time.

title: Mean matching exposes a systematic waiting-time bias in vaccination models
